title: PreferenceRecordV1 (internal domain contract)
description: Adapt Taste record owned by the native Adapt core (engine/crates/membrane-adapt::record). Identity derives deterministically; authority effect is computed by deterministic classification, never taken from model output. Internal contract, not a public Membrane protocol shape.

id.description: Deterministic function of (scope, category, normalized rule).

rule.description: Original user-facing wording; identity uses the normalized form.

scope_dimensions.description: Declared applicability dimensions; malformed present dimensions fail closed and cannot broaden eligibility.

avoid_alternative.description: Counterfactual preferred-vs-avoided alternative for correction/edit/reject evidence.

authority_effect.description: Computed by deterministic classification from the rule text, never taken from model output.

lifecycle_state.description: Mutable envelope state (canon 5.7); changes only through receipted transitions. Excluded from the sealed semantic payload; nothing leaves retired.

semantic_digest.description: Digest of the sealed immutable semantic payload.
